evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: No evidence of tear is noted in medial meniscus in this study.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Focal mildly increased signal intensity in posterior horn of lateral meniscus on F/S PD sequence  (srs: 4, Img:13), but not visible on F/S T2WI, , maybe due to mortion artifact
evidence.Lateral OA: Mild subchondral hypointensity area in lateral femoral condyle on T1WI, in favor of mild subchondral sclerosis.
evidence.PF OA: Mild wearing of articular cartilage of patella and femoral trochlea, R/O grade 2 chondromalacia.
evidence.Effusion: No significant increased joint effusion of left knee joint.
evidence.Contusion: No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
evidence.Fracture: No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction noted at distal femur and proximal tibia and fibula in this study.
